package app

import (
	"net/url"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"alder/rt"
	rtesting "alder/rt/testing"
)

// TestAlderBrowser runs the gen_browser golden's tests (a test build of corpus browser-ok) as
// `alder test` does, with the app's routes and router options (Routes, Web()) for each test's
// browser and the Password fake's capability unwired (TestGen_Browser).
func TestAlderBrowser(t *testing.T) {
	rs := rtesting.Run(Tests, rtesting.Options{Tables: Tables, TestTables: FakeTables, Caps: Caps{}.Registry(), Session: TestSession(), Routes: Routes, Web: Web()})
	if len(rs) != 13 {
		t.Fatalf("%d results", len(rs))
	}
	got := map[string]rtesting.CaseResult{}
	for _, r := range rs {
		got[r.Module+" "+r.Name] = r
		if !r.OK {
			t.Errorf("%s %q: %+v", r.Module, r.Name, r)
		}
	}
	// RF3: the click posts the URL the page rendered, with the page's parameter, and the
	// re-render keeps it
	want := []string{"Db.insert User", "Db.insert Note", "Test.login", "Test.get Notes.Index", "Db.all Note", "Time.now",
		"Test.click Notes.Index.Toggle", "Db.all Note", "Time.now", "Db.get Note", "Db.update Note", "Db.all Note", "Time.now"}
	if tr := got["Notes.Index a click keeps the page's parameter"].Trace; !reflect.DeepEqual(tr, want) {
		t.Errorf("RF3 trace %q, want %q", tr, want)
	}
	// RF4: the login form through the fake
	want = []string{"Test.fake Password", "Db.insert User", "Test.get Auth.Login", "Test.submit Credentials", "Password.verify",
		"Db.first User", "Test.submit Credentials", "Password.verify", "Db.first User", "Session.put", "Db.all Note", "Time.now"}
	if tr := got["Auth.Login logging in through the form"].Trace; !reflect.DeepEqual(tr, want) {
		t.Errorf("RF4 trace %q, want %q", tr, want)
	}
}

// decode(encode(r)) == r for forms with a field of every kind (Text, Text.NonEmpty, Text.Url,
// Text.Secret, an app Text brand, an Int brand, Maybe Date, Maybe with a default, Bool, Int,
// Float, a union, Maybe of a refined Text), set and unset; and the encoding is the inputs': a
// checked box "True", an unchecked one absent, Nothing blank (a cleared input — absent would
// give a field with a default its default).
func TestEncodeDecodeForm(t *testing.T) {
	for _, r := range []Notes__Index__NewNote{
		{Title: "Milk", Due: rt.Just(rt.Date{Y: 2026, M: 2, D: 3}), Urgent: true, Priority: -12, Weight: 2.25, Kind: Note__Kind__Idea__, Remark: "a b&c", Contact: rt.Just("me@example.com")},
		{Title: "x", Due: rt.Nothing[rt.Date](), Urgent: false, Priority: 0, Weight: 1e-7, Kind: Note__Kind__Chore__, Remark: "", Contact: rt.Nothing[string]()},
		{Title: " y ", Priority: 9223372036854775807, Weight: 0.1, Kind: Note__Kind__Plain__},
	} {
		v := encode__Notes__Index__NewNote(r)
		back, errs := decode__Notes__Index__NewNote(v)
		if errs != nil || !rt.Eq(back, r) {
			t.Errorf("decode(encode(%s)) = %s, %v (encoded %v)", rt.Show(r), rt.Show(back), errs, v)
		}
		if _, ok := v["urgent"]; ok != r.Urgent {
			t.Errorf("urgent present = %v for %v", ok, r.Urgent)
		}
		if due, ok := v["due"]; !ok || (len(due) == 1 && due[0] == "") == r.Due.Ok {
			t.Errorf("due = %q for %s", due, rt.Show(r.Due))
		}
		if r.Urgent && v.Get("urgent") != "True" {
			t.Errorf("urgent = %q", v.Get("urgent"))
		}
	}
	v := encode__Notes__Index__NewNote(Notes__Index__NewNote{Title: "t", Due: rt.Just(rt.Date{Y: 2026, M: 1, D: 5}), Kind: Note__Kind__Idea__, Weight: 1.5, Priority: 3})
	if enc := v.Encode(); enc != "contact=&due=2026-01-05&kind=Idea&priority=3&remark=&title=t&weight=1.5" {
		t.Errorf("encoded %s", enc)
	}
	for _, r := range []Notes__Index__Prefs{
		{Site: "https://example.com/a?b=c", Pin: "s3cr3t", Tag: "home", Count: 7, Reminder: rt.Just(int64(5))},
		{Site: "http://x.org", Pin: "p", Tag: "", Count: -1, Reminder: rt.Nothing[int64]()}, // Nothing, not the default Just 3
		{Site: "https://y.dev", Pin: "q", Tag: "t", Count: 0, Reminder: rt.Just(int64(3))},
	} {
		v := encode__Notes__Index__Prefs(r)
		back, errs := decode__Notes__Index__Prefs(v)
		if errs != nil || !rt.Eq(back, r) {
			t.Errorf("decode(encode(%s)) = %s, %v (encoded %v)", rt.Show(r), rt.Show(back), errs, v)
		}
	}
	if got := encode__Auth__Login__Credentials(Auth__Login__Credentials{Email: "a@b.c", Password: "s"}); !reflect.DeepEqual(got, url.Values{"email": {"a@b.c"}, "password": {"s"}}) {
		t.Errorf("credentials %v", got)
	}
}

// The selector literals are parsed once, as package variables.
func TestSelectorVars(t *testing.T) {
	if !strings.Contains(rt.Show(rtesting.DocTextSel(selector__1, rtesting.ViewDoc(Notes__Show__view(Notes__Show__Model{Note: Note__Note{Title: "T"}}, Notes__Show__Session{})))), `Just "T"`) {
		t.Error("selector__1 is h1")
	}
}
